role: bounded mechanism diagnostic on already-used training scenes; no model training or benchmark selection
randomization: same per-episode RNG formula as closed runner, but no Q updates; fixed context is not a replay of historical evolving training tables
capture: first assistance request/action/exploration flag/kernel reason, original observation times, applied digital output, and physical tail to natural episode end
aggregates: first-assistance ownership/reason counts only; no task-success or collision-rate benchmark
interpretation: Two contexts differ in both epsilon and policy, so their difference is not an isolated epsilon intervention. A diagnosed explicit request trigger establishes only the mechanism in that sampled trajectory, not the cause of all historical failures.
